name: kanban
description: A kanban side pane: Active (Backlog, Claude, Human) and Inactive (Done, Cancelled, Suspended) sections over GitHub Projects or local .kanban/ cards.

backend.title: Card backend (default: auto)
backend.description: Where cards live. auto: GitHub Issues when gh is installed, signed in and a project board is found for this repo, else local .kanban/*.md files. github: GitHub only; shows what is missing instead of falling back. local: always .kanban/*.md files.

claudeLimit.title: Claude limit (default: 1)
claudeLimit.description: How many cards Claude works on at once (0 means no limit). Cards moved to Claude beyond the limit wait in a queue and start in order.

reconcile.title: Reconcile at turn end (default: on)
reconcile.description: At the end of a turn, remind Claude once to hand off, ask about or move a card it left in Claude. Off: no reminders.
